name: clearly
description: Your company brain + spatial canvas over MCP. Search org context (prompts, docs, decisions, facts) and write decisions back so they compound — AND drive an infinite Skia canvas: land code diffs, diagrams, codebase maps, and sticker sheets as real vector nodes your agent creates and the human annotates back. Use the canvas as mission control for a coding task (pair-on-canvas): the human pins a spec, you do the repo work and report diffs + status as cards they steer by inking. Bundles canvas skills (clearly-canvas, pair-on-canvas, ship-review, visualize, codebase-map, sticker-pack), company-brain usage (clearly-workflows), and setup (clearly-init).
